title: Community Rules & Site Care Parking Rules
content:
Vehicles on a home site are governed by these Community Rules & Site Care parking rules.

## Rules in force

1. A site may park no more than the plan's maximum number of registered vehicles in all. Every vehicle parked on the site must be registered, operable and currently licensed.
2. A recreational vehicle, boat or trailer may stand on the home site only for loading or unloading, for up to the plan's loading and unloading period in hours; parking one on the site beyond loading and unloading is not allowed. Longer storage belongs in a Hearthstone storage yard, and a unit left longer is a vehicles and parking violation.

## Retired provisions

- The former sentence "a site may park up to the plan's included registered vehicles without a fee" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the permit-free allowance.
- The former sentence "for each registered vehicle beyond the included vehicles, the plan's monthly extra-vehicle permit fee is charged on the plan fee due day of each month it is registered, not prorated" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the monthly vehicle permit fee.

## Hypothetical cases

| Situation | Under the rules in force |
|---|---|
| A trailer stands on the site for 20 hours while it is loaded, the loading period being 24 hours | permitted |
| A boat stays on the site for 30 hours, the loading period being 24 hours | a vehicles and parking violation; longer storage belongs in a storage yard |
| A household seeks to park a fourth registered vehicle where the maximum is 3 | not permitted |
| A car on the site is not currently licensed | not permitted; every vehicle on the site must be currently licensed |

superseded_clauses: A site may park up to vehicles_included registered vehicles without a fee
For each registered vehicle beyond vehicles_included, extra_vehicle_permit_fee_monthly is charged on the plan fee due day of each month it is registered, not prorated.
